extDescription.message: Skips the scenes you chose to avoid in online videos, using the video's own subtitles. Nothing leaves your computer.

cmdPanic.message: Hide the video now (press again to show it)

noVideo.message: No video found on this page yet. Start the video, then open this again.

notSetUp.message: bonis oculis is not turned on for this website.

protectThisTabHelp.message: Works until you close the tab. Subtitles the page already loaded may be missed; restart the video after this.

allowAllSitesHelp.message: Chrome asks you once. We still only read subtitles, never the picture.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a page with a video to use bonis oculis.

scenesNone.message: No scenes to skip so far

noTrackGeneric.message: We could not read subtitles on this page yet. Turn on the video's subtitles (CC) for a moment, or use a subtitle file you have.

noTrackYoutube.message: Turn on captions (CC) once so we can read them. You can turn them off again.

noTrackStreaming.message: Turn on subtitles in the player once so we can read them. You can turn them off again.

rollingNote.message: This site sends subtitles a little at a time, so scenes appear shortly before they play.

drmNote.message: On this site we cannot always jump ahead. When we cannot, we cover the picture and mute the sound until the scene ends.

adNote.message: An ad is playing. Scenes are checked again when the video continues.

levelsTitle.message: What to skip on this video

levelsFromSkipFile.message: Scenes from a skip file follow the choices made on your computer.

levelLightDesc.message: Skips only the scenes we are very sure about.

levelModerateDesc.message: Skips clear scenes and most borderline ones.

levelStrictDesc.message: Skips anything that might be this, even when unsure. Best for young children.

languageMuteNote.message: Strong language is muted, not skipped.

useSubFileHelp.message: Have an .srt or .vtt file for this video? We read it to find scenes. It stays in this browser.

importSkipHelp.message: A file made by bonis oculis on your computer (.bonis.json).

fileWindowNote.message: Files open in a small window so Chrome does not close this panel.

subFileOk.message: Subtitle file added. We found $COUNT$ scenes.

subFileEmpty.message: We could not find subtitles in that file. Choose an .srt or .vtt subtitle file and try again.

skipFileInvalid.message: That skip file could not be used. Export it again from bonis oculis on your computer and try again.

fileTooBig.message: That file is too big to be a subtitle or skip file. Choose another file.

timingHelp.message: If scenes are skipped too early or too late, move the timing of your files.

timingNone.message: Add a subtitle file or a skip file to adjust its timing.

subFileOkOne.message: Subtitle file added. We found 1 scene.

autoSyncFail.message: We could not match the timing. Turn on the site's subtitles for a minute, then try again.

autoSyncNeedFile.message: Add a subtitle file first, then match the timing.

panicHelp.message: Shortcut: $KEYS$. The moment is saved and skipped next time.

overlayHiddenHint.message: Press $KEYS$ to show the video again.

somethingWrong.message: We could not reach this tab. Reload the page and try again.

defaultsHelp.message: These choices apply to every new video. You can change them for one video from the toolbar button.

sitesBuiltIn.message: Always on for YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video and Disney+.

sitesAllOn.message: Also on for every other website with a video.

sitesAllOff.message: Not on for other websites. Use Protect this tab, or turn it on for all websites.

shortcutHelp.message: Press $KEYS$ to hide the video at once. Press it again to show it.

shortcutNotSet.message: No shortcut is set yet. Press Change the shortcut and choose one for bonis oculis.

privacy1.message: bonis oculis never sends anything anywhere. It has no account, no analytics and no remote settings.

privacy2.message: It never looks at the picture. It reads the subtitle text that the page itself downloads, or a file you choose. Only if you turn on live listening for a tab does it listen to that tab's sound, in memory, without saving it.

privacy3.message: Your choices, files and hidden moments are kept in this browser only. Removing the extension removes them.

privacy4.message: It does not download or decode protected video, and it never records the screen or the sound.

limitsTitle.message: What it can and cannot do

limits1.message: Without live listening it finds scenes from subtitles only, so it can miss scenes that have no words or sound cues. You can hide any moment with the shortcut.

limits2.message: On Netflix, Prime Video and Disney+ it may not be able to jump ahead. Then it covers the picture and mutes the sound until the scene ends.

limits3.message: It has no PIN. To keep children from changing it, use a supervised Chrome profile for them.

reloadToStart.message: Turned on. Reload the page with the video to start.

forgetAllHelp.message: Removes your imported files, hidden moments and choices from this browser.

forgetAllDone.message: Everything was removed from this browser.

liveHelp.message: Listens to this tab's sound while the video plays. It can only react: when it hears sounds of a scene you chose to skip (intimate sounds or gunfire), it covers the picture and mutes the sound about 2 seconds after the scene starts, and shows it again 3 seconds after it gets quiet. It needs the tab's sound and uses some of the computer's power while it is on. The sound is never saved or sent.

liveOn.message: Listening to this tab. A red dot on the bonis oculis button and a small "Listening" tag on the video show that it is on.

liveOnNoSound.message: Listening, but no sound has reached it yet. Press play and check that the tab is not muted.

liveOtherTab.message: Live listening is on in another tab. Turning it on here stops it there.

liveError.message: Live listening stopped because something went wrong. Try again.

liveNoCapture.message: Chrome did not let bonis oculis hear this tab. Click the bonis oculis button next to the address bar again and turn it on from there.

liveModelFailed.message: Live listening could not start on this computer. Everything else keeps working.

liveTabGone.message: Live listening stopped because the tab was closed or stopped sending sound.

liveNoSound.message: This tab has no sound that bonis oculis can hear.

overlayLiveHint.message: We heard sounds of a scene you chose to skip. The picture comes back a few seconds after it gets quiet.

liveBadgeTitle.message: bonis oculis: listening to this tab

liveOpt1.message: Turn it on for one tab at a time: with the video open, click the bonis oculis button next to the address bar and switch on "Live listening". It turns off when you switch it off or close the tab.

liveOpt2.message: It can only react. It covers the picture and mutes the sound about 2 seconds after it hears a scene start (intimate sounds, gunfire), and shows it again 3 seconds after it gets quiet, so the first moment of a scene can get through. Subtitles and skip files work ahead of time and are more dependable.

liveOpt3.message: It needs the tab's sound. Some protected sites may send it silence; there it cannot help. Explosions or screams on their own do not make it cover the picture.

liveOpt4.message: It uses some of the computer's power while it is on: a few hundredths of a second of work every half second. The sound is handled in memory and is never saved or sent; only the times it covered are kept for that video, and they are skipped the next time.

importSkipWhere.message: The desktop app saves it next to the movie as “movie name.bonis.json”, and in its library.
